Thanks — attached is our completed Redwood_IAM_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx (answers + evidence links) and a companion CSV with recommended SCIM attribute mappings (scim-attribute-mapping.csv). Quick summary below:

- SSO: Redwood supports both SAML 2.0 and OIDC (OIDC primarily for SPA/mobile flows). We support IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows.
- SCIM: SCIM 2.0 provisioning supported. User create/update/deactivate and group membership sync are supported. Group-to-role mapping is configurable via attribute mapping; see attachment.

- Admin controls: Org-level admins can delegate limited admin scopes (e.g., billing read-only, application admin, security admin). Audit logs for admin actions retained per your agreement (default 90 days for Hosted).

Hi Emma — following up on Mina's note with some technical clarifications from the engineering side. Apologies for the detail, wanted to ensure we call out exact behaviors you may test: 

1) SCIM group handling
- We support group membership provisioning and deprovisioning. When a user is removed from an IdP group, SCIM update will mark the user inactive or remove the resource depending on your mapping policy (see column "onMembershipRemove" in scim-attribute-mapping.csv).
- Group -> Redwood role mapping is performed during the SCIM sync pass. If multiple groups map to multiple roles, the union of role permissions is applied.

2) JIT provisioning and SSO binding
- OIDC: JIT provisioning supported via the OIDC claims mapping to create users at first login. You can opt to disable JIT and require SCIM-only provisioning.
- SAML: No automatic JIT by default; we typically recommend SCIM for provisioning paired with SAML for SSO.

3) Admin scopes and delegation
- Built-in roles: Viewer (read-only), Operator (deploy & monitor), Admin (full org operations).
- Delegated admin: you can create a scoped role (e.g., "Billing Admin") with only billing and invoice-read scopes. Delegation is enforced in the console and via API tokens.

4) Session and inactivity defaults
- Hosted defaults: session timeout 8 hours, idle timeout 30 minutes. These are configurable for Dedicated/Private customers.

5) Audit evidence
- We included links in the spreadsheet to relevant audit screenshots and our SOC 2 control mappings. If you need CSV exports of admin audit events for a specific period, let us know the window.

Accepting a short walkthrough would be helpful; I can demo a SCIM sync and show the group->role resolution logic.

Thanks,
